- 4 ounces (1/2 cup) of fruit juice  
- 3–4 glucose tablets  
- 1 tablespoon of sugar or honey  
- 1 tube of glucose gel (if available)  
**Do NOT give him food or drink if he’s confused or unable to swallow safely — this could cause choking.**
